textbookBox.concept: We measure short lengths in centimetres and longer lengths in metres. 1 metre is 100 centimetres.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: We measure short lengths in centimetres and longer lengths in metres. 1 metre is 100 centimetres.
beats.speakEn: We measure short lengths in centimetres and longer lengths in metres. 1 metre is 100 centimetres.

beats.en: A double number line helps: 1 m is above 100 cm, 2 m above 200 cm, and so on, each step times 100. So 5 m 40 cm is 540 cm, and 2 m 4 cm is 204 cm.
beats.speakEn: A double number line helps: 1 metres is above 100 centimetres, 2 metres above 200 centimetres, and so on, each step times 100. So 5 metres 40 centimetres is 540 centimetres, and 2 metres 4 centimetres is 204 centimetres.
